missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Охрана' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. The feminine noun ends in -а in its base form.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Охрану' is the accusative direct object of 'усилил'. The feminine ending -а shifts to -у in the accusative singular.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Охраны' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that security is lacking. The feminine genitive singular ends in -ы.

missions.phrase: Он обратился к охране за помощью.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Охране' takes the dative after 'к', showing the person turned to. The feminine dative singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Instrumental as agent. 'Охраной' takes the instrumental to mark the agent in this passive-like construction. The feminine instrumental singular ends in -ой.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Охране' takes the prepositional after 'в' to show the workplace. The feminine prepositional singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Охраны' follows 'две', which requires the genitive singular of a feminine noun. The ending -ы marks that form.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Охраны' is the nominative plural subject of 'дежурят', referring to several security teams. 'Разные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Охраны' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The feminine genitive singular ends in -ы.
Strategic focus: Dative of recipient. 'Охране' takes the dative as the object of gratitude after 'благодарен'. The feminine dative singular ends in -е.
